{{Quote|This is Darth Malgus to the Imperial strike force. The Emperor's prisoner&mdash;the escaped Jedi Master&mdash;has unwittingly led us to the Nanth'ri system. That is the location of the Foundry&mdash;an ancient alien space station embedded inside an asteroid.|Darth Malgus|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Nanth'ri system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kurost sector/Legends|Kurost sector]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nanth'ri/Legends|Nanth'ri]].
